shared_elements: standing/frontal anthropomorphic figure carved on an upright monolith
elaborate headdress or headgear above the face
symmetrical composition centred on a vertical axis
circular disc/rosette motifs on the chest area
curving arms/limbs indicated across the torso
bands of ornament crossing the body horizontally
justification: Both depict a single frontal anthropomorphic personage occupying the whole height of an upright slab, with a broad headdress at top, disc/rosette elements on the chest and horizontal ornamental bands across the lower body, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. But A is densely covered with intricate, deeply undercut interlocking scroll, mask and glyph-like motifs and small subsidiary figures, whereas B reduces everything to a few broad, shallow, highly schematic outlines with large blank areas, so the manner of depiction and level of elaboration differ sharply.
